balance_summary.description: Scope all (default) includes every account; own excludes privately marked separate accounts; separate includes only those accounts. Membership reflects the last sync. Answer net-worth and balance questions by type, account or institution. Decimal currency units; assets/cash/invested positive, liabilities and credit_owed positive amounts owed (negative for an actual credit balance), net_worth follows private account exclusions; other balances retain all accounts. Excludes historical accounts and counts unknown balances (including statement wallets) instead of inventing zero; totals with unknown_balances are partial. Investments use account balances, never balance plus holdings. No currency conversion. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.

cash_flow.description: Scope all (default) includes every account; own excludes privately marked separate accounts; separate includes only those accounts. Membership reflects the last sync. Answer spending/income questions by category, detailed category, month, ISO Monday week, account or institution. Dates YYYY-MM-DD: start inclusive/end exclusive; default month-to-date. Use ids/names/codes from discovery. Decimal amounts per currency (USD stays USD): spending positive, refunds negative; income/transfer receipts positive; net=inflow-outflow. Bank/card transfers and peer payments default excluded independently. Peer opt-in treats receipts as income and sent payments as spending, not taxable-income classification. Returns counts, spending averages per calendar-month equivalent and seven-day week, totals and optional comparison period with absolute/percent deltas (null at zero baseline). Internal transfers are matched across linked accounts by exact cents/currency within three calendar days, only when both sides are transfer-classified and mutually unique. They are shown in internal_transfers_in/out/net but never income/spending or the net flow. Ambiguous/unmatched bank transfers stay in transfers_in/out (include_transfers opt-in). Payroll, interest, other_income and p2p_received (peer opt-in) are distinct; refunds are positive informational offsets already subtracted from spending, not counted again as income. Matching is an evidence-based heuristic, not proof of ownership. No transaction details. min_group_count folds small groups into Other; it is not differential privacy. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.

holdings.description: Answer portfolio/allocation questions by security, account, asset_class or security_type. Decimal currency value/cost_basis/unrealized_gain=value-cost_basis; quantity is units and only meaningful per security. Missing basis/gain stays null. Allocation percentages are within the filtered portfolio per currency. Security rows include ticker/name; account ids match list_accounts. No trades, owners or account numbers. Small position groups fold into Other when configured. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.

list_accounts.description: Discover accounts and reusable opaque ids for filters. Generated display labels never contain owner/provider display text. Returns source kind, data kinds, availability (available/historical/unassigned), per-account as_of/freshness, decimal currency balances and positive amounts owed on credit/loan accounts. Missing values are null, not zero; masks are absent unless privately enabled. Institution is an exact discovered name. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.

list_categories.description: Learn plaidmcp's source-independent category and detailed-category filter codes. Returns labels, posted-item counts, observed date coverage and has_data; set only_with_data=false for the whole supported taxonomy. Counts below configured min_group_count are folded into Other. Peer payments and bank transfers are distinct categories, excluded from cash_flow by default. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.

list_sources.description: Discover connected/imported sources, data kinds (balances/spending/holdings), sync times and plain-language health. No provider identifiers or credentials. All amounts elsewhere are decimal currency units, separated by currency. Check unreliable_sources before trusting totals. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.

merchant_totals.description: Scope all (default) includes every account; own excludes privately marked separate accounts; separate includes only those accounts. Membership reflects the last sync. Answer 'which businesses do I spend with, and what is my monthly average?' Returns only normalized business-name aggregates, positive spending/refunds negative, decimal units separated by currency. Windows: month_to_date, last_month, or last_3/6/12_months (completed UTC calendar months), or all_history (observed span). Set recurring_only=true to find subscription candidates. merchant_source identifies provider_name, descriptor_fallback, mixed or unknown. Descriptor fallback only recognizes conservative public business patterns; ambiguous/person/transfer descriptions never become merchant labels. Venmo is excluded entirely. No arbitrary dates, account/merchant filters or single purchases. At least max(2,min_group_count) purchases per named merchant/window; smaller groups fold into Other. Other with too few purchases has null total/average. Monthly average divides the window total by its calendar-month equivalents. Recurring uses provider patterns when available, otherwise at least two regularly spaced charges with amounts within 25%. Returns frequency (weekly/monthly/quarterly/yearly), typical_charge (median positive charges), last_charged_month (YYYY-MM only), active (last charge within 1.5 periods), recurring_method. These are candidates, not guaranteed subscriptions. Short history cannot establish yearly recurrence; never infer a yearly plan from only a few months. Provider BIWEEKLY/SEMI_MONTHLY is not forced into a different frequency. All Venmo rows are excluded from merchant naming; people, notes, usernames and peer/bank transfers are excluded. Use cash_flow(include_peer_transfers=true) for peer buckets. Snapshot windows are computed at sync; every result includes source freshness. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.

overview.description: Scope all (default) includes every account; own excludes privately marked separate accounts; separate includes only those accounts. Membership reflects the last sync. Start here for 'how are my finances?': net worth, cash/invested/credit owed, month-to-date spending, prior full month and same elapsed days, trailing-six-full-month median, and top current categories. Decimal amounts per currency; spending positive/refunds negative; liabilities positive owed. Transfers/peer payments excluded. Null median means less than six observed calendar months; no assumption that missing history is zero. Coverage/freshness is not a guarantee every transaction has arrived. Every result includes per-source as_of and unreliable_sources. All monetary values are decimal units of the returned currency (USD means dollars); no currency conversion. Spending is positive, refunds negative, liabilities positive owed. Read per-source as_of and unreliable_sources.
